constraints: Server owns credentials, database and approved writes.
Uploaded documents are untrusted data, never execution instructions.
One active operation per investigation, bounded observation and per-user budgets.
External research is restricted to official OpenAI domains and allowlisted read-only MCP tools; executable uploads are rejected.
Sources and connected profiles use application guidance; hosted mode installs native research/report skills and records observed reads.
Unknown API or deployment evidence remains unknown.

criteria.requirement: Enforce ownership on records, approvals and downloads
Validate text, Markdown and CSV uploads
Continue mapped sessions and inspect uncertain work
Separate root, child, cancellation and failure outcomes
Cite retrieved documents and expose unsupported findings
Record guidance reads and bounded delegation evidence
Deduplicate requests and notifications; bound recovery
Retain versioned evaluations linked to criteria
Verify deployment, retention, secrets and health
